ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms retryable failures, an attempt cap and the retry-assertions flag are declared; it does not execute retries.
offer: Retry only explicitly transient failures with a bounded attempt count. Repeating a failed assertion until it passes changes the test contract and hides deterministic defects.

minimal.reason: List the failure types that may be retried, such as network timeouts. Retrying everything hides real defects, so name transient causes only.

mid.reason: Cap attempts at a bounded number, at least 3 declared. An unbounded retry masks permanent failure, so set the limit.

maximal.reason: Set retrying assertion failures to false. Repeating a failed assertion until it passes changes the test contract, so retry infrastructure errors only.

rule.reason: List the failure types that may be retried, such as network timeouts. Retrying everything hides real defects, so name transient causes only.
